title: Machine Learning-Based Prediction of Readmission Risk in Cardiovascular and Cerebrovascular Conditions Using Patient EMR Data
summary: XGBoost predicts readmission-time classes from a large Mayo EHR cohort and is compared with LACE+; reported evidence is retrospective and internally split.
